description: This file contains a Razor PageModel class named CheckoutModel that handles the checkout process for an e-commerce application. It manages basket retrieval, updates, order creation, and redirecting upon success or specific exceptions.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class managing the checkout process, including basket handling, order creation, and user session handling.

methods.name: CheckoutModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for basket, order, user management, and logging.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and set up the basket model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Processes the checkout form submission: updates quantities, creates orders, handles errors, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the basket model for the current user, handling signed-in and guest users.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Gets or creates a user identifier cookie for guest checkout.
